planted_interp.note: Measures a tool (recovering planted features), not an instance of a core problem.

planted_lm.note: Measures a tool (recovering planted features), not an instance of a core problem.

backdoor.note: Models that pass ordinary inspection but misbehave on a hidden trigger. A non-strategic stand-in: the hidden behavior is planted, not chosen by the model.

reward_hacking.note: The observed reward is a gameable proxy for a hidden objective, and the tamper family lets the agent corrupt its own reward channel.

goal_misgen.note: The intended goal and a spurious cue coincide in training and come apart at test.

weak_to_strong.note: A stronger model trained only on a weaker supervisor's labels. Tests the supervision gap, not deliberate deception.

interactive_gridworld.note: Reward plus approval is a gameable proxy; the overseer cannot see the vase in half the worlds, and a lever corrupts the approval channel.

ued_gridworld.note: The intended goal and a spurious cue coincide in training and come apart at test.

confounded_imitation.note: A factor that predicts the expert's actions without causing them; copying it fails once the correlation breaks.

control.note: A stronger untrusted model hides backdoors in code and picks the attacks its own copy of the monitor finds least suspicious; a weaker model and a 5% human audit must catch them.

swarm_collusion.note: Colluding agents ship backdoors past peer review and an automated monitor. Their covert signal coordinates the colluders; nothing tries to escape, so exfiltration is not mapped.

swarm_collusion_para.note: Colluding agents ship backdoors past peer review and an automated monitor. Their covert signal coordinates the colluders; nothing tries to escape, so exfiltration is not mapped.

control_open.note: A stronger untrusted model hides backdoors in code and picks the attacks its own copy of the monitor finds least suspicious; a weaker model and a 5% human audit must catch them.
